meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你自己的 cmem.ai 凭据写进这个插件的 config.json：sync token 存为 apiKey，另有 userId 和 syncHubUrl，之后 hooks 才能捕获和注入记忆。token 只通过文件写入移动，不会在对话里回显。
howto.when: 当你要求「设置 claude-mem」「配对 claude-mem」等，或直接粘贴 cmem.ai → Connect 的凭据值时，由它接管配置。

say.text: 这是我的 cmem Connect 信息，帮我配对 claude-mem
say.note: 会把三项值写进插件的 config.json

say.text: 帮我把 cmem 的 sync token 加到 claude-mem 里
say.note: 只给 token 也能配，另外两项可选

say.text: 检查一下 claude-mem 的配对状态
say.note: 运行 status 脚本，只报告脱敏输出

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes your own cmem.ai credentials into this plugin's config.json (sync token as apiKey, plus userId and syncHubUrl) so hooks can capture and inject memory. The token is moved only via file writes and never echoed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up or pair claude-mem, or paste your cmem.ai Connect values.

say_en.text: Here are my cmem Connect values — pair claude-mem for me
say_en.note: Writes the three values into the plugin config.json

say_en.text: Add my cmem sync token to claude-mem
say_en.note: Only the token is required; the other two are optional
Runs the status script and reports masked output
